note: Small family campground at 7364 KY-815, 11 miles west of Owensboro, in a wooded creek bend; some full-time residents alongside overnighters. Pool, playground and trails; rental campers and a cabin too. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $41 nightly (water+electric, 2 adults + 2 children, +$10 per extra guest), weekly $225, monthly $500, 7% tax, phone/contact-form booking. Added year-round season, dump, laundry, showers, extra-person and tax terms. Note: dropped the rate/hookup restatement, added the full-timer mix.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: $41 a night with water and electric (operator page read 2026-11-23) - under $50, no gateway needed. Google Maps 4.6 over 27 reviews, phone 270-229-2528. RV Life $$ (avg $35), 16 sites. Presence: working operator website with phone.

LONG-STAY (monthly $500, weekly $225 posted; operator-posted 2023 review: 'Nice laid back park with some full timers'): test 1 nightly stays sold - yes; test 2 posted nightly rate - yes ($41); test 3 booking - phone/contact form only; test 4 nightly share - UNMEASURED (no engine; fall imagery shows about 20 rigs on RV Life's 16 sites, several with sheds/decks that look settled); test 5 no lot sales seen. Not read as mostly seasonal on the operator's wording (it leads with nightly guests and family reunions), but the share is unknown.

Hookups: the operator page says only 'Sites offer water and electric'; an operator-posted testimonial claims '50A power on every site'. Amperage left unset. 'Black tanks are emptied every two weeks by a professional provider' suggests no sewer at most sites despite the 'full and partial hook-up' wording.

Pin 37.6847,-87.2762 is ~40 m from the site cluster seen on imagery (Google's point 37.6836,-87.2738 is the house/office ~230 m east): fine. Waterfront 'not waterfront' stands: the creek loops round the campground but a wooded bank 40+ m deep separates the sites from it.
